versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
controles.kjv: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
controles.livre: E estas são as gerações de Esaú, o qual é Edom.

versos.hebraico: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת־נָשָׁ֖יו מִבְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת־עָדָ֗ה בַּת־אֵילוֹן֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת־עֲנָ֔ה בַּת־צִבְע֖וֹן הַֽחִוִּֽי׃

controles.web: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
controles.kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
controles.livre: Esaú tomou suas mulheres das filhas de Canaã: a Ada, filha de Elom heteu, e a Oolibama, filha de Aná, filha de Zibeão os heveus;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲח֥וֹת נְבָיֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
controles.kjv: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
controles.livre: E a Basemate, filha de Ismael, irmã de Nebaiote.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־רְעוּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
controles.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
controles.livre: E Ada deu à luz de Esaú a Elifaz; e Basemate deu à luz a Reuel.

versos.hebraico: וְאָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת־יעיש וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

controles.web: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
controles.kjv: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
controles.livre: E Oolibama deu à luz a Jeús, e a Jalão, e a Corá: estes são os filhos de Esaú, que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת־נָ֠שָׁיו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת־כָּל־נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְאֶת־מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת־כָּל־בְּהֶמְתּ֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו׃

controles.web: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
controles.kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
controles.livre: E Esaú tomou suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas filhas, e todas as pessoas de sua casa, e seus gados, e todos seus animais, e todos os seus pertences que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã, e foi-se a outra terra de diante de Jacó seu irmão.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
controles.kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
controles.livre: Porque a riqueza deles era grande, e não podiam habitar juntos, nem a terra de sua peregrinação os podia sustentar por causa de seus gados.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
controles.kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
controles.livre: E Esaú habitou no monte de Seir: Esaú é Edom.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃

controles.web: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
controles.kjv: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
controles.livre: Estas são as linhagens de Esaú, pai de Edom, no monte de Seir.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן־עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן־בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
controles.kjv: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
controles.livre: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, filho de Ada, mulher de Esaú; Reuel, filho de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אוֹמָ֔ר צְפ֥וֹ וְגַעְתָּ֖ם וּקְנַֽז׃

controles.web: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Elifaz foram Temã, Omar, Zefô, Gatã, e Quenaz.

versos.hebraico: וְתִמְנַ֣ע׀ הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽאֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן־עֵשָׂ֔ו וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֶאֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת־עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
controles.kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.
controles.livre: E Timna foi concubina de Elifaz, filho de Esaú, a qual lhe deu à luz a Amaleque: estes são os filhos de Ada, mulher de Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָזֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּמִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּ֣ה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Reuel foram Naate, Zerá, Samá, e Mizá: estes são os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אָהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת־עֲנָ֛ה בַּת־צִבְע֖וֹן אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת־יעיש וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹֽרַח׃

controles.web: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
controles.kjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná, que foi filha de Zibeão: ela deu à luz de Esaú a Jeús, Jalão, e Corá.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכ֣וֹר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אוֹמָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז׃

controles.web: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
controles.kjv: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
controles.livre: Estes são os duques dos filhos de Esaú. Filhos de Elifaz, primogênito de Esaú: o duque Temã, o duque Omar, o duque Zefô, o duque Quenaz,

versos.hebraico: אַלּֽוּף־קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה׃

controles.web: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
controles.kjv: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
controles.livre: O duque Corá, o duque Gatã, e o duque Amaleque: estes são os duques de Elifaz na terra de Edom; estes foram os filhos de Ada.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֨חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
controles.livre: E estes são os filhos de Reuel, filho de Esaú: o duque Naate, o duque Zerá, o duque Samá, e o duque Mizá: estes são os duques da linha de Reuel na terra de Edom; estes filhos vêm de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת־עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
controles.livre: E estes são os filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú: o duque Jeús, o duque Jalão, e o duque Corá: estes foram os duques que saíram de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי־עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃ס

controles.web: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
controles.livre: Estes, pois, são os filhos de Esaú, e seus duques: ele é Edom.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי־שֵׂעִיר֙ הַחֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֥וֹן וַעֲנָֽה׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
controles.kjv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
controles.livre: E estes são os filhos de Seir horeu, moradores daquela terra: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Aná,

versos.hebraico: וְדִשׁ֥וֹן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
controles.kjv: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
controles.livre: Disom, Eser, e Disã: estes são os duques dos horeus, filhos de Seir na terra de Edom.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהֵימָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃

controles.web: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
controles.kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Lotã foram Hori e Hemã; e Timna foi irmã de Lotã.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּמָנַ֖חַת וְעֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפ֖וֹ וְאוֹנָֽם׃

controles.web: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
controles.kjv: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Sobal foram Alvã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefô, e Onã.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־צִבְע֖וֹן וְאַיָּ֣ה וַעֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת־הַיֵּמִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּרְעֹת֥וֹ אֶת־הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים לְצִבְע֥וֹן אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
controles.kjv: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Zibeão foram Aiá, e Aná. Este Aná é o que descobriu as fontes termais no deserto, quando apascentava os asnos de Zibeão seu pai.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת־עֲנָֽה׃

controles.web: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
controles.kjv: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Aná foram Disom, e Oolibama, filha de Aná.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃

controles.web: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
controles.kjv: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
controles.livre: E estes foram os filhos de Disom: Hendã, Esbã, Itrã, e Querã.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן וַעֲקָֽן׃

controles.web: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
controles.kjv: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
controles.livre: E estes foram os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã, e Acã.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃

controles.web: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
controles.kjv: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
controles.livre: Estes foram os filhos de Disã: Uz, e Harã.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַחֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לוֹטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שׁוֹבָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְע֖וֹן אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה׃

controles.web: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
controles.kjv: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
controles.livre: E estes foram os duques dos horeus: o duque Lotã, o duque Sobal, o duque Zibeão, o duque Aná.

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר׃פ

controles.web: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan: these are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
controles.kjv: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
controles.livre: O duque Disom, o duque Eser, o duque Disã: estes foram os duques dos horeus: por seus ducados na terra de Seir.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei sobre os filhos de Israel, foram estes:

versos.hebraico: וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּאֱד֔וֹם בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן־בְּע֑וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃

controles.web: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
controles.kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
controles.livre: Belá, filho de Beor, reinou em Edom: e o nome de sua cidade foi Dinabá.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃

controles.web: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E morreu Belá, e reinou em seu lugar Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃

controles.web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E morreu Jobabe, e em seu lugar reinou Husão, da terra de Temã.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עֲוִֽית׃

controles.web: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
controles.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
controles.livre: E morreu Husão, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, filho de Bedade, o que feriu a Midiã no campo de Moabe: e o nome de sua cidade foi Avite.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃

controles.web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E morreu Hadade, e em seu lugar reinou Samlá, de Masreca.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃

controles.web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E morreu Samlá, e reinou em seu lugar Saul, de Reobote do rio.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־עַכְבּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan, the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
controles.kjv: And Saul died, and Baal–hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
controles.livre: E morreu Saul, e em seu lugar reinou Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּמָת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן־עַכְבּוֹר֒ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
controles.kjv: And Baal–hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
controles.livre: E morreu Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor, e reinou Hadar em seu lugar: e o nome de sua cidade foi Paú; e o nome de sua mulher Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Mezaabe.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠אֵלֶּה שְׁמ֞וֹת אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לִמְקֹמֹתָ֖ם בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃

controles.web: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
controles.kjv: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
controles.livre: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos duques de Esaú por suas linhagens, por seus lugares, e seus nomes: o duque Timna, o duque Alva, o duque Jetete,

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃

controles.web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
controles.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
controles.livre: O duque Oolibama, o duque Elá, o duque Pinom,

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר׃

controles.web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
controles.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
controles.livre: O duque Quenaz, o duque Temã, o duque Mibzar,

versos.hebraico: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה׀ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֗וֹם לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃פ

controles.web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
controles.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
controles.livre: O duque Magdiel, e o duque Hirão. Estes foram os duques de Edom por suas habitações na terra de sua possessão. Edom é o mesmo Esaú, pai dos edomitas.
